newsitem.title: USA: American Freightways names new board member.
newsitem.headline: American Freightways names new board member.

text.p: American Freightways Corp said it named former Congressman John Paul Hammerschmidt to its board of directors.

Hammerschmidt retired in 1993 after serving 26 years as the U.S. Representative for the Third District of Arkansas. He also serves on the board of Dillard's Inc, First Federal Bancshares of Arkansas Inc and Southwestern Energy Co. He is also chairman of the Northwest Arkansas Council and as a member of the Arkansas Economic Development Commission.
